idea-plugin.name: Warden Navy
idea-plugin.description:
Two dark naval themes inspired by the Warden navy of the game Foxhole.

  • Warden Navy Blacksteele: gunmetal hull, wooden deck and banner blue.
  • Warden Navy Nakki: deep water, sonar green and periscope glass.

Each theme ships a matching editor colour scheme, background artwork, icons and a naval progress bar.

Fan-made. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Siege Camp.
